linear_counterpart_poles_zeros.interpretation: Unwarped-Tustin continuous-time equivalent of minimal full C(s)=kp*LP*(PD+wi/s)*N; H/Wi cancellation removed; multiplicities retained

controller_filter_poles_zeros.interpretation: Unwarped-Tustin continuous-time roots with multiplicities; finite zeros only. HIGS states are nonlinear and have no LTI poles; origin is the inherent I structure.

controller_only_command_summary.interpretation: Logged-error controller-only replay plus the same logged FF; counterfactual command, not the new closed-loop tracking performance

replay_spectra.replay_type: controller-only actual ControllerAlgorithm with A=B=0; reference input is each logged error; LP input equals error because lpPre has 0 sections
replay_spectra.motion_rule: abs(gradient(reference)/Ts) > 1 percent of trajectory maximum (minimum 1e-8 rad/s)
replay_spectra.selection_rule: equal trial weight; geometric centre of largest LP energy band gives fmin; first higher octave with >=10 percent derivative energy gives fstart; Wi is tuned separately by closed-loop case-b error

offline_plant.source: E4: fixed FF rigid body plus measured in-motion resonance fit
offline_plant.discretisation: ZOH with 256 implicit Coulomb substeps per sample
offline_plant.host: actual unmodified ControllerAlgorithm; scratch host extends only the offline plant with G case-b friction

provenance: true-notch fixed-bound independent bandwidth maximisation on coherence-qualified moving composite plant; separate sup norms; Wi tuned on case-b low-frequency error; no HIGS-win tuning
df_method: Search: log-interpolated sampled HIGS DF; final: direct sampled law at every measured line. LS sine/cosine/DC, phase=.317rad, n=max(768,ceil(16fs/f)), skip=max(256,ceil(6fs/f)); loaded unwarped-Tustin SOS for every LTI factor
nyquist_assumptions: Composite .1..4999Hz with analytical rigid-body DC continuation; no RHP plant poles; rigid-body pole + controller integrator at DC; type-2 indentation; HF closure to zero inside unit disk; finite-grid DF Nyquist-type only

low_frequency_sensitivity.plant_interpolation: Composite design plant; exact rigid-body response below20Hz and real/imaginary interpolation above
low_frequency_sensitivity.low_frequency_requirement: integrator lies in the p198 separation band

noise_replay.method: exactly constant REF; head .2s excluded, retain >=.1s; demean position; reset each segment; replay 5 periods and measure last command AC RMS; duration-pooled
noise_replay.rig_choice: 10mA is approximately 0.4 percent of 2.71A, chosen for this rig; not a book value
noise_replay.caveat: recorded standstill position includes mechanical motion and drift

resonance_detection.rule: Largest coherence-qualified in-motion load-position peak in150..400Hz; one notch per limiting elastic resonance

design_plant.definition: Below20Hz FF rigid body; 20..400Hz linear ramp FRF at coherence>=.8 only; above400Hz standstill ms100

low_frequency_model.mismatch_sign: model / measured; phase wrapped to [-180,180] degrees
low_frequency_model.threshold_rule: maximum absolute mismatch over coherence-qualified 20..50Hz lines: >3dB or >20deg

design_plant.transition: No accepted lines at20..29Hz; first accepted31Hz; constraints use only stated lines and log-frequency crossover interpolation between adjacent samples, including19.999..31Hz gap

simulation_fit.mass_split_source: Existing ms060 fit jm=5.066e-5,jl=3.982e-5; preserve ratio and scale total to FF J
simulation_fit.note: Load-position FRF does not identify mass split; existing split is fixed and total J/B retained. Twist prediction depends on this split.
simulation_fit.sampled_response_definition: C(zI-Ad)^-1 Bd z^-DELAY, exact ZOH atTs; C=[0,0,1,0]; moving Coulomb increment zero; includes sample/hold phase
